spec_match.rationale: Checks the exact IDL across all three surfaces: createSendGroup on the transport prototype, WebTransportSendGroup's lone own getStats, WebTransportSendStream's direct WritableStream inheritance with exactly sendGroup/sendOrder/getStats/getWriter as own members, inherited abort, and both illegal constructors.

interactive.rationale: One button runs every check against the real objects and renders observed-vs-IDL rows; the stats panel explains the shared dictionary and defers real calls to the workbench.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the member-by-member interrogation including illegal constructors; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Absent-interface rows are skipped with explicit text; the partial-surface case (some but not all three) is named in the verdict; the WebTransportWriter row is informational for engines that ship it separately.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus 5235261159112704, the send-stream and send-group spec sections.

conformance.rationale: New 10-assertion suite mirrors these checks plus call-time dictionary conversion and two honest manual live assertions (stats invariants, transferability); executes 0 pass / 8 fail / 2 blocked on Chromium 141 — all absence, honestly.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): run driven at 1280×900 and 360×740, overflowX 0, zero failed requests, clean console; the all-absent verdict rendered with the flag pointer. Partial: the shape rows need a 153+/flagged build to evaluate.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the probe ran with the three surface booleans; no transports constructed on this page, so nothing to leak.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; yes/no/na cells pair emerald/rose/muted with text; buttons set both colors.

accessibility.rationale: Captioned table with th scope, native button, single polite verdict region, textual cells.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at both classes with 0px horizontal overflow; monospace member names break; both screenshots read.
